title: Did black bands see themselves as dance orchestras
summary: He cannot answer with accuracy but says bands from Spanish Fort and the country club did the same mix of popular and jazz tunes.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves

blocks.x: Yeah. Did the, did the black bands also think of themselves as dance orchestras?

I can't answer that with any accuracy, but the, the, there were some dance bands, because I can think of some of the big bands that played, uh, for instance, out of Spanish Fort. This was what, about a 10 to 11, 12 piece band. And then some of the bands that played at the, uh, New Orleans Country Club, but they did precisely the same things. That, they'd play music, popular music, and then they'd play a couple of jazz tunes. So the, the custom was actually a New Orleans custom, rather than a band custom, or let's say a white band custom, or anything else.
